headlines.title: 코스닥 300억·코스피 500억 …상폐기준 강화 6개월 늦춘다
headlines.summary: 시행 시점 내년 1월→7월로 연기 정부, 시장 회복 시간 필요 판단 코넥스 이전 허용으로 충격 완화 정부가 내년 1월부터 시행할 예정이었던 코스피·코스닥 상장폐지 시가총액 기준 추가 상향을 6개월 유예하기로 했다. 시장 회복에 일정 기간이 필요하다는 판단에 따른 조치다.

headlines.title: 스테이블코인 실증 전 제도 공백 ‘ 혼란 ’
headlines.summary: 헥토 등 디지털자산 新서비스 추진 USDC 원화정산 외환법 해석 난항 외국인 결제·정산도 교환구조 따져야 디지털자산기본법 입법 지연에 혼선 전통 금융회사가 규제 불확실성에 발이 묶인 사이 핀테크 기업들이 제도 공백 속에서 스테이블코인 실증 사례를 잇달아 내놓고 있다.

headlines.title: 공공기관 109개 줄인다…"수도권 잔류 최소화"
headlines.summary: <앵커> 정부가 공공기관 109곳을 줄이는 대대적인 구조 개혁에 나섭니다. 발전과 항만 분야 기관들은 합치고, LH는 기능별로 쪼개는 등 판을 다시 짜겠다는 겁니다. 수도권 공공기관의 2차 지방 이전도 공식화했는데요. 대상으로 거론되는 금융권 노조의 반발이 거세지고 있습니다. 김예원 기자입니다.

headlines.title: 2차 공공기관 이전 ‘ 30조 청구서 ’ 나오나 [H-EXCLUSIVE]
headlines.summary: 1차 이전 105곳에 9조1796억원 투입 2차 규모 3배…단순 환산 땐 30조원 2030년 후 임대계약 남은 기관 14곳 임대차 계약 해지에만 수백억원 들어 정부가 서울에 남아 있는 공공기관의 ‘최소 잔류’ 원칙을 밝힌 가운데 수도권에 잔류 중인 공공기관의 이전에 발생할 임대차 계약 해지 비용만 수백억원에 이를 수 있다는 분석이 나온다.

headlines.title: 배치전환·근무지 변경은 교섭 …공공기관 이전 노사갈등 예고
headlines.summary: 이전·통폐합, 경영상 판단 교섭 제외 수당 등 근로조건 바뀌면 가능해져 지침근거 교섭거부 적법성 보장안돼 정부가 내년부터 수도권 공공기관의 2차 지방 이전을 본격 추진하기로 하면서 이전에 따른 직원 배치전환과 근무지 변경 등이 노사 교섭의 주요 쟁점으로 떠오를 전망이다.

headlines.title: 평택 반도체부터 진도 풍력까지 … 美 4개기업 2.7조 투자
headlines.summary: 산업부·코트라, 투자신고식 양국 공급망 협력 강화 기여 반도체 소재·장비 및 청정에너지 분야 미국 첨단기업 4곳이 한국에 총 20억 달러(약 2조7000억 원)를 투자한다. 대규모 반도체 생산 기반과 탄탄한 산업 생태계를 갖춘 한국의 강점이 투자 배경으로 작용한 것으로 풀이된다.

key_headlines.title: Delisting Standards Postponed by Six Months
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's government has delayed the implementation of stricter delisting criteria for KOSPI and KOSDAQ by six months, moving the deadline from January to July 2027 to provide markets with recovery time.

key_headlines.title: Four U.S. Advanced Tech Companies to Invest $2.7 Trillion in Korea
key_headlines.summary: Four major U.S. companies in semiconductors, materials, equipment, and clean energy sectors will invest approximately $2.7 trillion in South Korea, strengthening bilateral supply chain cooperation.

key_headlines.title: July Current Account Surplus Reaches Record $42.1 Billion
key_headlines.summary: Korea's July current account surplus hit a record $42.1 billion, driven by semiconductor exports, maintaining the world's second-largest surplus after China in the first half of 2026.

key_headlines.title: Delisting Impact Reduced Through KONEX Transfer Without Liquidation
key_headlines.summary: The government now permits qualifying companies to transfer to KONEX without liquidation procedures, maintaining existing stock prices to mitigate delisting shock.

key_headlines.title: Nvidia to Acquire Hugging Face for $13 Billion
key_headlines.summary: Nvidia is acquiring Hugging Face, the world's largest AI model sharing platform, for approximately $13 billion, expanding its dominance from semiconductors to AI software ecosystem.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's government announced a six-month delay in implementing stricter delisting criteria for KOSPI and KOSDAQ companies, moving the deadline from January 2027 to July 2027 to allow market recovery. Simultaneously, four major U.S. advanced technology companies will invest approximately $2.7 trillion in Korea across semiconductor, materials, equipment, and clean energy sectors. The government is also introducing measures to soften the impact of delistings, including allowing qualified companies to transfer to KONEX without liquidation procedures while maintaining existing stock prices. These policy adjustments aim to stabilize market confidence while attracting foreign investment.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's July current account surplus reached a record $42.1 billion, representing the second-largest surplus globally in the first half of 2026 and the 39th consecutive month of current account surpluses. Semiconductor and IT product exports continue to drive strong performance, with economists projecting annual current account surpluses could reach $450 billion. The government has allocated 62 percent of additional tax revenues to a future response fund to control fiscal expansion and minimize inflation risks. Key economic indicators for the coming week include U.S. producer price data and consumer price index figures, with major central banks expected to deliberate on interest rate decisions.
sections.Financial Markets: KOSPI recovered to the 6,600 level and KOSDAQ returned above 800, buoyed by positive signals from U.S. Federal Reserve officials suggesting potential rate pauses in September if inflation pressures continue to moderate. Financial holding companies showed strong performance, with Shinhan Financial Group rising 3.6 percent to record highs and other major financial stocks demonstrating resilience amid market volatility. U.S. Treasury yields declined over two consecutive days following dovish comments from Fed officials, supporting positive sentiment in global bond markets. The prospect of lower interest rates and reduced rate hike expectations continues to provide tailwinds for Korean equity markets.
sections.Industry & Technology: The Democratic Party is prioritizing a 392 trillion won mega-project for semiconductor and display manufacturing in the Chungcheong region for next year's budget allocation. Geely's E2 electric vehicle achieved five-star ratings from both Euro NCAP and ANCAP, demonstrating advanced safety features including high-voltage battery protection systems. The government is implementing a 50 percent discount on electric vehicle charging rates during weekend and holiday hours from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. through the end of September to encourage EV adoption. South Korean companies OnItsAI and FuriosaAI jointly developed a private AI appliance based on domestic NPU technology, targeting regulated sectors like finance and public services requiring strict data security.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation's long-term jeonse tenants show an average residency period of 6 years and 9 months, with 72 percent reportedly moving to purchase their own homes after the program. The government is considering a dramatic 1.2-fold increase in floor area ratio limits for private reconstruction and redevelopment projects in Seoul to improve project feasibility and address long-standing challenges in housing supply. Long-term homeowners in major Seoul redevelopment apartments face difficult decisions regarding tax burdens, with some considering selling immediately while others await potential policy changes. Officials express concerns that expansionary fiscal policy under high inflation and interest rates could stimulate real estate prices while burdening non-homeowners and small business owners.
sections.International Economy: Federal Reserve officials, including Christopher Waller, signaled openness to holding interest rates steady in September if inflation pressures continue to moderate, supporting expectations for potential rate pauses rather than increases. The Bank of Japan is expected to raise its policy rate by 25 basis points in September, though the decision may be influenced by the Federal Reserve's September policy announcement. South Korea's Industry Minister Kim Jeong-gwan emphasized discussions regarding potential U.S. semiconductor tariffs will follow the principle of non-discriminatory treatment toward Korea compared to other competitors. Cryptocurrency assets gained alongside the dovish Fed commentary, with Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies strengthening on expectations of lower U.S. interest rates.
sections.AI & Economy: Nvidia is acquiring Hugging Face, the world's largest AI model sharing platform, for $13 billion, expanding beyond hardware dominance into software and AI model distribution ecosystems. Domestic data center investments will require approximately 19 trillion won through 2030 to meet growing AI and cloud service demands, according to industry estimates. OnItsAI and FuriosaAI jointly developed a private AI appliance using domestic NPU technology, enabling generative AI and AI agent operations in closed networks for regulated industries requiring strict data governance. Research indicates AI will exacerbate job market mismatches, with high-demand sectors like finance and consulting facing high AI replacement risks while aging societies require more human-intensive care services.
sections.Others: Nvidia is reportedly in discussions to invest $3.4 trillion in Singking Machine Lab, an open-source AI startup founded by OpenAI's former Chief Technology Officer, signaling major venture capital activity in the AI sector. Korean investors are heavily betting on yen appreciation, with major domestic banks' yen deposits exceeding 11 trillion won at exchange rates around 850 yen per dollar, driven by expectations of Bank of Japan rate hikes and declining yen valuations. Konkuk University is operating 'AX Leader Strategy Programs' for Nonghyup employees, including AI-based real estate and ETF investment training with robo-advisor practical exercises. Iran's economy continues deteriorating under U.S. sanctions and blockade measures, with citizens reporting daily increases in poverty amid worsening inflation pressures.
